title: Radiographic and histomorphometric comparison of two-stage maxillary sinus floor augmentation using different grafting materials: a systematic review and network meta-analyses of randomized controlled trials
html: This study was performed to evaluate the various commercially available materials used in two-stage maxillary sinus floor augmentation (MSFA). Comprehensive searches were conducted across PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and Scopus up to October 2, 2025. A manual search was also conducted to complement the electronic search. The analysis was restricted to randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that reported both radiographic and histological evaluations. Studies that did not incorporate graft materials were excluded.
